base.alt: Concept image: a bright, empty kitchen during a remodel, with dated walls and the old cabinets gone, before any design work.

baseVariants.prompt: A realistic photograph of an EMPTY kitchen space during a remodel, with all the old cabinets removed in an ordinary 1990s to 2010s Midwest American suburban house, not a loft and not luxury. Bright, open and airy: big windows, lots of soft daylight, light floors. Finished drywall, a bright window on the back wall where the sink will go, capped plumbing and outlets only, a light plank floor. Eye-level camera standing in a corner. One large, plain, completely clear main wall is fully visible and unobstructed. Nothing hangs on the walls. No people, no plants, no text, no logos. Natural colour, gentle shadows, 4:3 photograph. The walls are painted a dated, tired butter yellow that looks a little greasy.

editInstruction: Keep EVERYTHING that already exists exactly as it is: the same camera position, lens, framing, walls, wall colour, trim, window, floor, light and furniture. Keep the lighting and exposure identical: do not darken, re-light or add shadows to the walls, floor or ceiling beyond a soft contact shadow directly under the new item. stages.caption: A kitchen is built from the back wall out: oak cabinets, a quartz top, a deep sink under the window.
Glossy tile behind it all, easy to wipe and full of light.
Then the island, which is where everyone will stand anyway, and the range.
Two smoked-glass globes over the island.
Stools to pull up, and open shelves instead of upper cabinets, so the room stays airy.
A board, a bowl of lemons and a pot of herbs, like someone cooks here.

final.alt: Concept image: the finished modern kitchen with white oak cabinets, quartz counters, a tile backsplash, an island with stools and globe pendants.
